campaigns.pageSubtitle: Step into your persistent, AI-steered adventures or forge an entirely new living realm
campaigns.emptySubtitle: The archives are silent. Forge your first campaign to awaken the autonomous AI Dungeon Master, generate a unique world map, starting factions, classes, races, and lore.
campaigns.modalSubtitle: Provide a name and describe the realm you envision. The AI Dungeon Master will dynamically construct its geography, factions, classes, races, and lore.
campaigns.namePlaceholder: e.g. Chronicles of the Shattered Crown
campaigns.promptPlaceholder: e.g. A grimdark fantasy realm where ancient celestial titans fell and their decaying essence warps the land. Arcane magic is strictly forbidden by the zealot Sunlit Inquisition. Remote mountain tribes cling to primal blood-rites...
campaigns.promptGuideDesc: Describe what kind of world this campaign should be. Detail the mood (e.g. grimdark, high magic, gothic horror, cosmic mystery), magic density, dominant factions, geography, conflicts, or mythological roots. The AI DM will weave these details into your world map, starting factions, classes, races, and lore.
